inputHint: Paste an array of JSON objects or open a JSON file.
flattenHint: Turn nested objects into columns such as contact.city. Arrays stay in one cell.
emptyPreview: Add JSON or load the example to see the spreadsheet here.
previewCount: Showing {rows} of {totalRows} rows and {columns} of {totalColumns} columns.
invalidJson: Check the JSON syntax and try again.
invalidRecords: Enter a non-empty array of objects, such as [{"name":"Maya"}].
noColumns: Add at least one field to create a spreadsheet column.
sheetLimit: Split the data to fit Excel’s limit of 1,048,576 rows (including the header) and 16,384 columns.
cellLimit: Shorten the field names or values that exceed Excel’s 32,767-character cell limit.
readError: Couldn’t read this file. Try opening it again or paste its contents.
downloadError: Couldn’t create the Excel file. Try downloading again or use fewer records.
